column4: ;; EHP parity fixture — exercises every capture in queries/highlights.scm.
;; This file is read by BOTH consumers through the same query. It is a
;; HIGHLIGHTING fixture, not a program: it must PARSE with zero ERROR nodes
;; (an ERROR region yields no captures and would bake a hole into the golden),
;; but it is not required to type-check.
;; Keep it stable. Changing it changes the golden, and the golden is the
;; contract the two editors are held to.
;; --- keywords the grammar does NOT tokenize (identifier-matched) ---
;; --- typed + bare params, angle return type ---
;; --- TWO fused typed params.  The type of a fused param is ATOMIC, so `Point`
;;     must NOT absorb `p2`: this parsed as `p1 : (Point p2)` with `:Point`
;;     stranded as an ERROR until 2026-08-15 (DEFERRED 134), on a shape the
;; --- spec with builtin + applied types, plus a metadata entry: the
;;     EHP P3 because the fixture exercised only ONE of @attribute's four
;;     sites, which is how three of them stayed vacuous unnoticed. ---
;; --- relational form (Rel T1): defr, ||, &>, =, logic variables ---
;; --- path selection: dot DESCENDS · brace SELECTS · `^` RE-KEYS.  Every
;;     branch name is a KEY (@property) and the SUBJECT is not (@variable).
;;     Added 2026-08-15 with DEFERRED 135's fix: without a path form here
;;     the golden could not hold the distinction.  Deliberately avoids the
;;     `^-` collapse family, which the grammar cannot parse (DEFERRED 136)
;;     and which would put an ERROR node in the fixture. ---
;;     The `^-` COLLAPSE family (Q_T7) and the parent collapse `^..`
;;     (Q_T8). Could not be in the fixture until 2026-08-15 — the grammar
;;     could not parse them (DEFERRED 136) and they would have planted an
;;     ERROR node in a fixture required to parse clean. ---
;; --- typed hole (`??`, distinct from a `?x` logic variable) ---
